contexts.text: They who have written on natural theology.
They call the doctrine of charity and of life moral theology. AC 9300:8. NJHD 257:2. AE 789:2. AE 796:2.
In England there is a twofold theology; one from the doctrine of faith, and the other from the doctrine of life; the former with the priesthood, the latter with the laity.
The writers on natural theology have not derived anything such (as relates to the immortality of the soul) from themselves; but merely confirm those things which they know from the Church...
(The present Faith, or theology, stated seriatim.)
This agrees with the mode of speech of the theologians...
Everything of religion... has been banished from the sight of man by the dogma... that theological things, which are spiritual ones... are to be believed blindly...
The priests, being then in theological zeal... CL 354.
Upon this they build all theology. Signified, Explained.
The universal doctrine of the Salvation of man, which is called theology, is at this day this faith, consequently is the woman Jezebel.
A discussion as to whether anyone can see any doctrinal theological truth in the Word, except from the Lord.

AR 702. That from a theology founded upon the doctrine of a Trinity of Persons... and upon the doctrine of justification by faith alone... there arise mere reasonings and cupidities of falsifying truths. Signified, Explained.
To be drunken = to be insane in spiritual things, that is, in theological ones.
They who have confirmed themselves in the dogma that the understanding is to see nothing in theological things... cannot see any truth in the light.
All that which precedes with a theologian, and composes his erudition...
How I, from being a philosopher, became a theologian. Explained.
What Christian theologian does not study philosophy in the schools, before he is installed as a theologian? From what other source has he intelligence?

He said. As you have become a theologian, explain what is your theology. I replied, These are its two principles: There is One God; and, There is a conjunction of charity and faith. He replied. Who denies these principles? I rejoined, the theology of the present day, when interiorly examined.
That the universal theology in the Christian world at this day has been founded on the idea of three Gods...
That the dogmas of this theology appear to be erroneous, after the idea of a Trinity of Persons has been rejected...
Theological things reside in human minds above all others...
The idea of three Gods in theological things may be compared to...
Many will say, How can theological things be perceived in the understanding...
(Title). The True Christian Religion, containing the Universal Theology of the New Church...
From the division of the Divinity into three Persons... a sort of frenzy has gone forth into universal theology...
For Divine things, which are called theological, constitute the Church.
Thus not only is the unity of God divided, but also theology itself...
This does not enter properly into a theological system such as that of this book...
For God... is the all in all of theology.
From this idea of God and redemption, universal theology has from being spiritual become in the lowest degree natural. Explained.
For on a just idea of God depends the universal theological body.
Then no genuine theological truth is perceived in its internal form...
The doctrine of justification by this faith alone... reigns with the clerical order, almost as the one only theological thing.

In what region of the mind reside theological things? At first I believed that they are in the highest region... Then an Angel stood before me, and said, Theological things, with those who love truth because it is truth, rise up into the highest region... (But) with those who love truth only for the glory of their reputation, theological things reside in the ultimate region, where scientifics are. (Continued. See Region.)
For faith enters into the parts of a theological system, as the blood into the members...
On account of the mystical and enigmatical faith which makes every point of the present theology.
What a... theological meagreness there is at this day. Explained.
For what is anything theological without the understanding?
For spiritual things, which are called theological, reside in the highest region of the mind, like the soul in the body. Explained. CanonsNC 5. God 2. 9.
Cannot anyone think... after he has studied theological things, of the particulars (of these subjects)?

I asked, If you make man a pillar of salt in spiritual things, what are your theological things? -Are they not spiritual? They replied, In our universal theology there is nothing spiritual which reason apprehends. Explained.

To enter with the understanding into dogmas of faith composed from Own intelligence (causes) the understanding to be closed above, and gradually below also, to such an extent that theological things not only cause disgust, but are also obliterated...
Consequently, without truths there is no theology; and, where there is not this, there is no Church. Such is the condition at this day...
Such would all students of theology become, unless genuine truths from the Word were opened by the Lord.
If one of these three (faith, imputation, and the merit of Christ) were taken away, the present theology would become nothing...
For at this day the universal theological system hangs on this imputation, as a long chain does on a fixed hook.

From which this faith has been seen as if it were true theology itself... If, therefore, while reading the Word, they were to think of any other than this imputative faith, that light, together with all their theology, would be extinguished; and a darkness would arise by which the whole Christian Church would vanish. It has therefore been left to them, like the stump of roots in the earth... until seven times pass over ().
Free nations, in relation to the spiritual things of the Church, which are called theological, are like eagles...
There are like differences between the judgment of the one and that of the other in the mystical Things of theology. Explained.

Bedbugs are those who have been theologians, and have believed that religion is nothing but a political affair, which they have affected while supposing that when they die they will die altogether; and that theological things may be of service to them in the world to persuade and to dominate by.
For they reject good works from their theology, and consign them to moral doctrine.
They had scarcely wanted to hear about spiritual truth, except merely the first theological rudiments.
I said to them that it is not good to devote one's self to theology and piety unless the Lord and the Word are acknowledged.

It was afterwards shown of what quality they are who have not denied God, the worship of God, and the theology, but still have not reflected anything thereupon... They very much lamented that interiorly they are honest and have something internal, which pains them... Good things to eat do them no good; everything good effects nothing with them. Bye and bye they throw themselves into some business; but as soon as it is over, it comes again. They like to eat horseradish, strong.

There was a certain person who in his youth had read the Word diligently; and afterwards, because he did not understand it, he rejected it from his attention, saying to himself that moral or natural theology teaches better... He came to the Angels; and they told him what use the Word performs: that a moral life without a theological life effects no use; it does not purify from evils, and alone does not conduce to eternal life...
(This English bishop) was examined as to what he knew in theology; and he knew nothing but confirmations of the received faith...

The Philistines counselled that this should be done; for at that time a knowledge of correspondences and representations was common; for this was their theology, well known to the priests and diviners...

Where are the truths which should be of faith, and the goods which should be of life, which must make the genuine doctrine from the Word, and the derivative theology, in the Christian world?... Many in the Spiritual World, and all in Heaven, wonder that the theology in the Christian world has been reduced to such inanity and vacuity that at last it has all been brought within the compass of an utterance of thought which may be made even by the evil at the hour of death...
Yet this faith, although it is empty, fills the entire theology of the Christian world.

Close the understanding, bring forth reasonings, and cite confirmations from the sense of the letter of the Word, and you can persuade yourself of anything you wish, especially in theological things, which ascend into the interiors of the rational mind.

There is a thought of light concerning God, and Divine things, which in Heaven are called celestial and spiritual things, and in the world ecclesiastical and theological things; and there is a thought not of light concerning them. Explained.

In theological things, concerning anything whatever, the idea is formed according to each person's understanding; and this is the case also with those things of which it is said that the understanding must be kept under obedience to faith. Explained.
From these things it is evident that (the Moravians) have hatched their theology from their skull, and have afterwards consulted the Word...
The English have a twofold theology; one for the learned, and one for the unlearned.

Trinity. 10. 7. God, faith, and charity are the three essentials of the Church, and on them universal theology, thus the Church, depends. And therefore where falsities are taught concerning these three things, and are imbued, man has not salvation.
All theologians, when preaching, know nothing of the falsities of their religion. Explained.
The universal modern theology is nothing else than the Divine omnipotence. Explained.
